items.t: Transmission slips, drops into neutral or shifts hard
items.job: Transmission fluid and filter service as a first step
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $242 to $293 for the service. If the clutches are worn, a rebuild costs several thousand dollars.

items.t: Intake manifold gaskets leak coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets with updated metal-core gaskets
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $851 to $1,013 on 1996-2001 models.

items.t: Spider fuel injector leaks or misfires
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $627 to $861 on 1996-2001 models.

items.t: Misfire from a worn distributor cap and rotor
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $122 to $191.

items.t: AWD lights flash and AWD stops working
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $549 to $798 on 2002-2004 models. Wiring repairs cost less.

items.t: Cooling fan roars or engine runs hot
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $782 to $1,045 on 2002-2004 models.

items.t: Blower runs only on some speeds or quits
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $156 to $213 on 2002-2004 models.

items.t: Power window pops when going up
items.job: Apply anti-noise tape to regulator; replace regulator if it fails
items.note: The tape fix is cheap; a new regulator is about $264 to $407.
